payload.description_html:
Dorsal and caudal vertebrae of Troiidon. vnlidu8 (Lambe). No.2, Univ. of Alberta. Fig. I-Median caudal vertebra. Side view. Fig. 2-Third (?) caudal vertebra. Side view. Fig. 3-Median caudal vertebra. Side view. Fig. 4-Sacra-caudal vertebra with left caudal rib. Anterior end. Fig. 5-The same. Side view. Fig. 6-Distal caudal vertebra. Side view. Fig. 7-Distal caudal vertebra. Side view. Fig. 8-Median dorsal vertebra. Side view. Fig. 9-The same. Front view. Fig. lO--Anterior dorsal vertebra. Side view.

All three-fourths natural size.
